hero.headline: AI teammates with shared memory for your company.
hero.subheadline: Unison is an AI-native workspace where AI co-workers remember your company context, turn decisions into tasks, and execute work. AI co-workers are shared across the team, so multiple humans can steer the same AI co-worker while staying in control.

problem.title: Your AI tools forget everything.
bullets: Paste the same context into every tool, every time
GPT forgets what you decided yesterday
Copy outputs from one AI co-worker into another
No single place where AI knows your company
problem.closingLine: Your AI tools don't talk to each other. Unison fixes that.

solution.title: A workspace built for humans and AI co-workers
solution.body: Unison is where AI teammates live. AI co-workers work alongside your team inside the workflow, with shared context across conversations, docs, and tasks.

items.title: AI co-workers that remember your company context
items.body: AI co-workers operate with full workspace memory. They retain decisions, documents, conversations, and past work so you don't have to repeat yourself.

items.title: Centralized tools and knowledge
items.body: Bring chat, docs, tasks, and AI execution into one workspace so context doesn't get lost between tools.

items.title: Shared AI teammates for the whole team
items.body: AI co-workers belong to the workspace, not a single user. Multiple people can collaborate with and steer the same AI co-worker.

items.title: Create your own AI co-workers and share them internally
items.body: Build specialized AI teammates for your workflows, then publish them to your workspace so everyone can use them.

workflow.title: From meeting to shipped work
workflow.intro: Here's what Unison does for a typical product meeting:

steps.title: AI co-worker joins your meeting
steps.body: Unison's AI co-worker attends and captures the conversation with full company context.

steps.title: Creates structured output
steps.body: It generates a meeting summary, decisions made, and action items.

steps.title: Turns outcomes into tasks
steps.body: It creates tasks in the workspace: assigns owners, sets priorities, and links context.

steps.title: AI co-workers execute deep work
steps.body: AI co-workers can start work like competitor research, drafting a spec, or analyzing feedback.

steps.title: You approve before anything is shared
steps.body: AI co-workers draft outputs. Humans review and approve before sending or publishing.

items.title: Never lose a decision again
items.body: Every meeting becomes structured knowledge. AI co-workers capture the discussion, extract decisions, and generate clear follow-ups automatically.

items.title: Turn conversations into tasks
items.body: Decisions instantly become tasks with owners, priorities, and context. No manual task creation. No forgotten action items.

items.title: Execute work in the background
items.body: AI co-workers don't just summarize. They run research, draft specs, analyze feedback, and prepare reports using your company context.

items.title: Draft first, humans approve
items.body: AI co-workers prepare outputs and suggestions. Humans review and approve before anything is shared or sent.

items.title: Keep the team informed automatically
items.body: AI co-workers report progress, surface blockers, and update the team so everyone stays aligned without constant status meetings.

points.title: AI teammates, not AI features
points.body: Unison treats AI as a collaborator that operates inside the workflow, not a sidebar that generates text.

points.title: Shared memory and shared AI co-workers
points.body: AI co-workers retain company context inside the workspace and can be used by multiple people on the team.

points.title: Real work with approvals
points.body: AI co-workers do deep work and request approval when something is ready to share or send.

points.title: Create and share your own AI co-workers
points.body: Build specialized AI co-workers for your team's workflows and make them available across the workspace.

controlSafety.title: Human control, always
controlSafety.closingLine: AI co-workers operate transparently and default to human approval.

items.a: Unison is for newly formed, AI-reliant teams (2-20 people) who want shared AI co-workers with persistent company context, centralized knowledge, and approvals by default.

items.q: Do AI co-workers send messages or updates automatically?
items.a: No. AI co-workers draft outputs and ask for approval; humans review and approve before anything is shared.

items.q: How is Unison different from using AI inside tools like Notion or Slack?
items.a: Most tools add AI as a feature that generates text. Unison makes AI a teammate with shared memory that participates in workflows, creates tasks, and executes work inside the workspace.

items.q: Can I create my own AI co-workers?
items.a: Yes. You can create specialized AI co-workers for your workflows and share them with your team inside the workspace.
Yes - use the Watch Demo link. If you want to try it with your team, request access.
